title: Green Hope AI joins the creative projects list
summary:
Two community contributions: an editable thumbnail project for the showcase and a standalone email utility.

Green Hope AI was added to the creative projects list. It generates thumbnails and lets people adjust text, placement, styles, and effects without starting over.

Jay-1409 added a separate Next.js utility for sending custom and welcome emails through Brevo or Resend, with reusable templates for other messages. It is not connected to existing Pollinations services.
